messages:
Aisha Khan: Fyi — vendor portal just flagged our marketplace reservation for us-west4 as 'inventory mismatch'. It still shows as reserved but the SKU on their side is H100-80GB while our contract and commit are for A100-40GB. New ETA is 'TBD'.
Sam Li: Ugh. Which vendor? can you paste the reservation id?
Aisha Khan: Vendor: NebulaRack via cloud-marketplace partner listing. Reservation ID: `RES-768291`. Link: https://vendor.example.com/res/RES-768291 (requires SSO)
Ken Ortega: If portal switched SKU we need immediate confirmation if they can honor equivalent throughput. H100 -> A100 performance differs; cost/commit implication.
Priya Shah: Do we have flexibility to accept the H100s? That could break billing and committed capacity math. Finance needs to sign off before we accept.
Leo Martinez: Copying the contract clause — we can accept 'equivalent or better' hardware if vendor provides written confirmation and pricing parity. Need vendor statement.
vendor-portal-bot: SYSTEM: Reservation RES-768291 status changed to INVENTORY_MISMATCH at 2026-11-17T14:05:12Z. Partner notes: 'Temporary SKU reallocation due to A100 supply shortage'.
Sam Li: OK I'll open a formal ticket with NebulaRack now. @Ken @Priya — will ask for written SKU swap proposal with pricing and ETA within 24h.
Ken Ortega: Also ask NebulaRack to confirm passthrough on marketplace listing (so customers see updated SKU) or to map A100 pricing to H100 for our commit period. We can't retroactively change committed units.
Priya Shah: We'll need a temporary credit hold on billing until legal reviews vendor confirmation. @Leo can you draft a quick email for the finance/legal handoff?
Leo Martinez: On it. Drafting now. Will include clause references and ask for vendor bridge call.
Aisha Khan: Quick ops note — if they insist on H100 only, can we accept and re-quantize our Dedicated capacity? Potential perf/regression to test. @Sam please capture an inventory snapshot and sample instance specs.
Sam Li: Snapshot: `inventory_snapshot_1827091123.json` uploaded to drive. Contains SKU, serial ranges, and vendor notes.
Ken Ortega: We should block any automated rollout that would route traffic to those reserved nodes until this is resolved. @Infra team FYI.
Priya Shah: Agreed. Holding any capacity allocation changes. Also scheduling a short partners call with NebulaRack tomorrow 09:00 PT. Sam, can you get them on the call?
Sam Li: I'll ping their partner_eng and schedule.
vendor-portal-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Please respond to discrepancy ticket #NR-4557 within 24 hours to avoid automatic deallocation.
Aisha Khan: Thanks — next steps: 1) Sam open ticket + schedule call; 2) NebulaRack to provide written SKU swap + pricing parity; 3) Leo to draft finance/legal note; 4) Ken to coordinate routing hold with infra; 5) Priya to approve temporary billing hold. I'll keep this thread updated. :white_check_mark:
Ken Ortega: Sounds good. If vendor balks, we escalate to marketplace ops for deallocation and request re-fulfillment window.
Priya Shah: Noted. If we take H100s temporarily we need an eval runbook (latency/cost delta) — Priya will own.
Sam Li: Ticket created: https://nebularack.support/tickets/NR-4557 — invited NebulaRack partner_eng to the call.
Aisha Khan: Closing the loop here: update me when NebulaRack confirms in writing. I'll push an all-hands note to partnerships if the ETA slips past 3 weeks.
Ken Ortega: Thanks all.
